title: Fateful Friends SMP
description: A 16+ whitelisted custom Cobblemon server. We're about your adventures and the friends you meet along the way. Join our discord to complete the whitelist process.
body:
# We are a Whitelisted Server
Please apply to join via our [discord](https://discord.gg/n72s8ebpVB)!
# About Us
Fateful Friends is a 16+ whitelisted Minecraft server focusing on Cobblemon. Our community is about your adventures across the world and all the friends you will meet along the way. Whether you're an expert builder aiming to create awe-inspiring structures or a master trainer looking to catch only the strongest Pokemon, we're hopeful to be friends! Our community values creativity, kindness, and above all, a passion for adventure!
# Features
- Limited Minecraft Mobs
- Villagers and Wandering traders are the only passive vanilla spawns.
- Hostile mobs only spawn from spawners.
- Pokemon you catch have boosted item farming capabilities.
# Player Towns
This is only a sample of the important areas of the server.
- **Ariseon Town:** Our world spawn.
- **Astoria Town:** Our shopping district.
- **Anglenn Bay:** A place for socializing and fishing.
- **Abaddon Ruins:** An ancient city hidden deep underground.
# How to Join
1. Join our [discord server](https://discord.gg/n72s8ebpVB).
2. Verify you read and understand our rules.
3. Post an introduction in our Trainer Registry.
4. Wait for approval from the staff team.
